news.title: NASA administrator, federal leaders to visit Iowa State
news.summary_en: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman, along with leaders from other federal agencies, will visit Iowa State University and Ames National Laboratory on Tuesday, Sept. 8. news.title: Iowa State-led team uses data and AI to design next-generation organic electronic materials
news.summary_en: Iowa State's Wenjie Xia is leading a team developing data-driven, materials-by-design approaches to discover organic electronic materials. The materials could be used for flexible electronics, wearable sensors, bioelectronics and other emerging technologies.

news.title: New ISU demonstration site to put public spotlight on water-quality best practices
news.summary_en: With help from a $1 million federal grant, Iowa State University is developing the Watershed Innovation Farm – a demonstration site for showcasing nature-based water-quality measures such as saturated buffers, bioreactors and wetlands.
